validated_results.title: Modern Breeding and Biotechnological Approaches to Enhance Carotenoid Accumulation in Seeds.
validated_results.reason: This is a narrative review summarizing breeding and biotechnological strategies for carotenoid accumulation in seeds, with no original human data on astaxanthin and prostate cancer incidence.

validated_results.title: Modern Breeding and Biotechnological Approaches to Enhance Carotenoid Accumulation in Seeds.
validated_results.reason: The article is a review of transgenic and breeding approaches that only mentions proposed protective effects of lycopene, providing no original human incidence analysis.

validated_results.title: Modern Breeding and Biotechnological Approaches to Enhance Carotenoid Accumulation in Seeds.
validated_results.reason: The article is a plant-science review with no original human study of zeaxanthin and incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Blood fatty acid patterns are associated with prostate cancer risk in a prospective nested case-control study.
validated_results.reason: Risk estimates are reported only for principal-component fatty acid patterns ("Pattern 1, which mainly reflects polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolism"), so no PUFA-specific estimate is separable.

validated_results.title: Do studies reporting 'U'-shaped serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D-health outcome relationships reflect adverse effects?
validated_results.reason: The paper is a narrative review of reported U-shaped 25(OH)D–health outcome associations rather than an original human study of vitamin D and incident prostate cancer.

validated_results.title: Polyunsaturated fatty acids and prostate cancer risk: a Mendelian randomisation analysis from the PRACTICAL consortium.
validated_results.reason: The report uses Mendelian randomization or genetic instruments, which this protocol excludes.

validated_results.title: eNOS gene polymorphisms in paraffin-embedded tissues of prostate cancer patients.
validated_results.reason: The study examines eNOS gene polymorphisms in prostate cancer tissue and controls, providing no population-wide nutritional nitric oxide exposure estimate.

validated_results.title: Opportunities and challenges in incorporating ancillary studies into a cancer prevention randomized clinical trial.
validated_results.reason: This methodological report on ancillary studies within SELECT presents adherence analyses and non-prostate endpoints, with no prostate cancer incidence results.

validated_results.title: Opportunities and challenges in incorporating ancillary studies into a cancer prevention randomized clinical trial.
validated_results.reason: The paper describes the conduct of ancillary studies with endpoints "other than prostate cancer" and reports no selenium–prostate cancer incidence estimate.

validated_results.title: Opportunities and challenges in incorporating ancillary studies into a cancer prevention randomized clinical trial.
validated_results.reason: No prostate cancer incidence results for vitamin E are reported; the article addresses opportunities and challenges of adding ancillary studies to the trial.

validated_results.title: Vitamin D and urological cancers.
validated_results.reason: The article is a literature review of vitamin D and urological cancers based on Medline and Web of Science searches, not an original human study.

validated_results.title: Role of vitamin D receptor gene Cdx2 and Apa1 polymorphisms in prostate cancer susceptibility: a meta-analysis.
validated_results.reason: This is a meta-analysis of vitamin D receptor gene polymorphism studies rather than an original human study of vitamin D exposure and incident prostate cancer.
